review.purpose: Deeper frozen test of Bootstrap-v134: omit illustrative examples, retain defining alternatives/parts/restrictions, preserve uncertainty and derive natural supported titles. Three independent draws; no old semantic judgments are gold.
review.selection: Eight People contexts (two original and six held out), sixteen broad/specific pairs and eight original controls. Held-out notes are SHA256-ranked with bootstrap-no-examples-deep-v1, excluding the initial panel and selected earlier notes; specific entries maximize depth then subject length, requiring depth >= 2 and >= 6 whitespace words. Selection precedes outputs.
